decisions.reason: Bleaching tray blanks fit the firm's dental workflow materials business and were given dedicated product-page support, so despite being a competitive consumable they are likely worth retaining.
The PETG thermoforming blank is a close fit with the company's laboratory materials and digital production positioning, making discontinuation relatively unlikely unless sales are weak.
The UV-curing lacquer is a smaller accessory product with less visible prominence, but it complements the firm's custom-device manufacturing processes and can stay as a useful add-on.
Custom hearing protection earmolds align well with the company's hearing-care channels and core custom-manufacturing capabilities, so management would likely continue the line.
